meta.title: Klarna Bonus - Free Spins, Welcome Pack & VIP Offers
meta.description: Klarna Casino bonus system covers no deposit free spins, a €1,200 welcome package, weekly promos, and a 10-level VIP programme. Check terms before you claim.

h1: Claim Your Klarna Bonus - Pick the Offer

intro.text: Klarna bonus programme covers offers from the no deposit welcome gift to our ten-level VIP programme. Bonus terms update regularly, so always check the current offer details before you claim.

content.text: Once your account is verified, the 50 spins activate immediately. During registration, enter the Klarna promo code if you have one.

items: Maximum cashout: €30 from free spin winnings
Wagering requirement: x30 - applied to deposit funds, not free spin winnings
Activation: promo code entry in your account cabinet is mandatoryъ

content.text: Each stage activates automatically when you make a qualifying deposit.

items: Minimum deposit: €10 / Bonus: 100% match up to €400
Minimum deposit: €10 / Bonus: 75% match up to €400
Minimum deposit: €10 / Bonus: 50% match up to €400

content.text: The Klarna deposit bonus conditions are identical across all three stages - maximum €400 per stage, x35 wagering on free spin winnings, x45 on bonus funds.

We run deposit promotions twice a week for all registered players (Wednesday and Friday). The exact percentage and spin count vary week to week, so check the promotions section before you deposit to see the current offer. Both promotions stack with loyalty programme rewards.
Every registered player gets one free Fortune Wheel spin per day at no cost. The wheel distributes bonus funds, free spins, and exclusive casino offers. Prizes credit automatically - no claim needed.
Klarna VIP programme runs across ten levels, rewarding consistent play with cashback, free spins, and personal bonuses. Points accumulate automatically with every wager - you never need to opt in.

items: Levels 7-10 (Sapphire and above): wagering drops to x3

content.text: From Sapphire level upward, players also receive personal no-wagering bonuses, priority withdrawals, early access to new promotions, and a birthday gift. The jump from standard cashback to the Sapphire tier is the most significant milestone in the programme.

items: Space out your welcome deposits: take each stage separately, assess your balance, then decide on the next deposit amount
Activate the Klarna promo code before your first deposit: the no deposit free spins may expire if you deposit first
Reach Silver fast: the jump from Bronze requires 8,000 XP and unlocks 3% cashback immediately
High rollers should focus on cashback over deposit bonuses: at Sapphire level, x3 wagering on cashback is significantly easier to clear than x45 on bonus funds
Priority support: players depositing via Klarna Pay receive priority queue access to our support team

faq.title: How to withdraw free spin winnings?
faq.text: Once you complete the x30 wagering on the no deposit free spins, any remaining balance up to €30 becomes withdrawable. For welcome package free spins, the requirement is x35, and cleared winnings convert to real funds up to the applicable limit.

faq.title: What happens to my Klarna bonus status if I take a break?
faq.text: Your accumulated XP stays on your account. However, extended inactivity may affect status maintenance at higher VIP levels. Check the VIP terms in your account settings or contact our support team directly to confirm your current status before returning to play.

faq.title: Do weekly promotions require a separate opt-in each time?
faq.text: Most weekly offers activate automatically when you deposit on Wednesday or Friday. Some specific promotions may require clicking a claim button in the promotions section before depositing - always check the individual offer terms on the day before you top up.
